content: It is essential to take this medication as prescribed. If you miss a dose, consult your doctor or pharmacist immediately to establish a new dosing schedule. Storage Instructions: Refer to the product instructions or consult your pharmacist for proper storage guidelines. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Discard this product appropriately when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific needs. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your individual health requirements. Precautions: Before using anidulafungin, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, other echinocandin antifungal drugs (e.g., caspofungin, micafungin), or any other substances. This product may contain inactive ingredients (e.g., polysorbate 80) that could cause allergic reactions or other complications. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if clearly necessary. It is unknown whether this medication passes into breast milk. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all products you use (including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products) and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: In the event of an overdose with severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Notes: Laboratory and/or medical tests (e.g., liver function, potassium blood levels) should be conducted while using this medication. Missed Dose: It is crucial to take each dose of this medication as scheduled. If you miss a dose, contact your doctor or pharmacist promptly to determine a new dosing schedule.
